title: Canonical ADR template prepared for Architecture Studio indexing
objective: Create the canonical Markdown ADR template and stable authoring conventions so future decisions remain human-readable canonical sources and can later be indexed as traceable Graph IR evidence for the Architecture Studio.
validations: The ADR template contract check passes with 11 ordered metadata fields, 12 required sections, controlled statuses, valid local Markdown links, and Graph IR v1-compatible relation mappings.
An in-memory copy/index simulation produces a discoverable ADR-0014 filename, matching title, and deterministic metadata map without writing a fake ADR to the repository.
TEMPLATE.md does not match the real ADR discovery pattern while ADR-0014-example-decision.md does.
The coordination validator passes with 15 task records after the immutable Claude handoff was added.
git diff --check passes; only the repository's existing LF-to-CRLF checkout warning is reported.
No dependency, lockfile, Graph IR generator, generated graph, Nx, CI, master source, or current planning file was changed.
risks: The 13 historical ADRs retain heterogeneous metadata and require explicit compatibility handling when ADR extraction is implemented; they were not mechanically rewritten.
I-004 currently targets Nx projects, targets, and dependency edges, so full ADR indexing may remain a later I-006 extractor extension.
GRAFTING_MASTER_SOURCE.md and CURRENT_PLANNING_STATE.md still describe G-005 as open until the I-004 owner incorporates the completed handoff while already editing those shared planning files.
